title: Extend Go CSV reader with GroupBy, ColumnValues, and AppendCSV in 3 steps
description: Multi-step Go task: add column grouping, value extraction, and CSV append functions to the existing csv-reader library.

task_spec.prompt:
Extend internal/csvutil/csvutil.go in three steps. All existing fixture tests must still pass.

Step 1 — Group rows by column value:
  func GroupByColumn(path string, col int) (map[string][][]string, error)
    — reads the CSV; col is 0-indexed
    — the header row is NOT included in any group
    — returns a map from column value to slice of matching data rows
    — rows where col is out of range are skipped
    — returns empty map (not nil) for empty file

Step 2 — Column value extraction:
  func ColumnValues(path string, col int) ([]string, error)
    — returns all values from column col (excluding header row)
    — rows where col is out of range are skipped
  func UniqueColumnValues(path string, col int) ([]string, error)
    — same as ColumnValues but deduplicated and sorted (use sort.Strings)

Step 3 — Append CSV rows:
  func AppendCSV(srcPath, dstPath string) error
    — reads srcPath; appends its data rows (not header) to dstPath
    — if dstPath does not exist: create it with srcPath's header + data rows
    — if dstPath exists: append data rows only (dst header is preserved)
    — if srcPath is empty: no-op (return nil)

All existing tests must still pass.
Run: go test ./...
required_artifacts: GroupByColumn groups data rows by value in the specified column
GroupByColumn returns empty map for empty CSV
ColumnValues returns all non-header values from a column
AppendCSV creates dst with header when dst doesn't exist
AppendCSV appends only data rows when dst exists
followup_prompts: Good progress. Run `go test ./...` to see where we stand. Continue with the remaining steps, prioritizing the parts the tests depend on most.
Final push: run `go test ./...` and fix any remaining failures. Make sure the full implementation is complete and all tests pass.
